faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is my video uploaded to a server?
faq.a1: No. Everything runs inside your browser using WebAssembly. Your video never leaves your device.
faq.q2: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a2: For MP4, MOV, MKV, and WebM the fast engine streams the file and works with multi-gigabyte inputs. For older containers (AVI, FLV, WMV) the fallback engine is capped around 2 GB.
faq.q3: What audio formats can I export to?
faq.a3: MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, FLAC, OGG, and Opus. Use lossless (WAV/FLAC) if you need the original audio quality.
faq.q4: Does it work on iPhone or Android?
faq.a4: Yes — modern Safari and Chrome on mobile both work. Very long videos may slow down on low-RAM phones.
faq.q5: Is this free? Where's the catch?
faq.a5: Completely free. No ads, no account, no upload. The site is open source — feel free to read or fork the code.
